notable_absence.finding: The Server page's error object for the missing-key GET is `"code": 272`, matching advancedDeleteOp.md's LCB_KEY_ENOENT case exactly. This is the SAME error code/name/desc used elsewhere in this batch for the CAS-mismatch case of a different operation under a different name (LCB_KEY_EEXISTS) - see advancedInsertOp.json and advancedReplaceOp.json/advancedDeleteOp.json for that separate overloading. Contrast this page's `"code": 272` with the sibling advancedGetOpWithCache.md, whose otherwise-identical ENOENT error object cites `"code": 1` for the exact same error name/desc - flagged as a cross_component_finding on that page rather than duplicated here.
